fixes.explanation: Ooh, I see you squinting at that one, friend, and I get it. But it's true. The song says, “Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.” (1 Chronicles 16:34) Earlier the song just said to give thanks (1 Chronicles 16:8), and this time the reason comes attached. I second-guess my own oven timer every single batch, so you're in good company.

Rule over every nation? Friend, that's a lot of cookie boxes to fill, and it isn't in this cry. It says, “…that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.” (1 Chronicles 16:35) The reason given is thanks and praise. The people ask to be saved so they can give thanks, not so they can take over.
